headline: Wesley Fofana booed by Chelsea fans against Nottingham Forest over interview comments
description: Chelsea fans booed Wesley Fofana during the early stages of the visit to Nottingham Forest after his controversial unauthorised interview.

headline: Is Arsenal-Man City still the biggest PL match of the season?
description: Arsenal vs. Man City was supposed to be the Premier League's marquee fixture, but it feels anything but in light of City's guilty verdict. What does Sunday's game really mean?

headline: Emery hails Garnacho's 'fantastic' attitude despite Aston Villa exclusion
description: Unai Emery has praised the attitude of forgotten man Alejandro Garnacho and has insisted there is no bad blood between the pair.

headline: Arteta won't call Man City clash a title decider
description: Mikel Arteta plays down the significance of Arsenal's Premier League clash with Manchester City.

headline: Tottenham's Sávio out for rest of 2026 with hamstring injury - De Zerbi
description: Roberto De Zerbi has confirmed that Tottenham are set to be without Sávio for the rest of 2026 and beyond due to a hamstring issue sustained late on against Ipswich.

headline: Maresca: I'm not a magician after four months at Man City
description: Manchester City head coach Enzo Maresca has hit back at criticism aimed at their current poor form in the Premier League.
